_note: Expeditions (SanctuaryBrain 'expedition' option): a clue she has actually read or heard becomes a reason to set out on foot - a real multi-day journey (JourneyDirector) with Luna. Offered only to the lead mage, when both are fit, from an area with a road there, until what it sought is known (done_if). Nothing is scheduled: the planner weighs it against everything else she could do.
